probe_finding: Definition (deep-scroll catalog, 2026-10-15): @StephenKrupka's team pace/style family — seconds per play (pace), DROE (dropback rate over expected: how much more/less a team drops back than situation predicts), 1st-down pass rate, play-action rate, and pre-snap motion rate, published as team style profiles. Role in-engine: style is a premise input, not a curiosity — pace drives play volume (and therefore every counting stat and total), DROE and 1st-down pass rate describe an offense's intentions before the defense is even considered, PA rate interacts with the coverage-split family (C-283), and motion rate is a defensive-disguise stressor. This family is the standing weekly form of the style facts tonight's SEA@DEN dossier reasoned from by hand (short-week vertical suppression, two-high clock bleed).
